scope_note: Topic primary outcome: 3-point major adverse cardiovascular events. All-trial MACE pooled HR is closest; six-trial prior-CVD strata are not substituted. ELIXA used four-point MACE while other trials used three-point, explicitly disclosed in text. k digit comes from the all-eight-trial caption; Table 2 independently prints MACE All 8. Model proposal declares the listed source set complete for the selected comparator outcome; this is not a claim of eligibility equivalence with our pool.
